_comment: The settings a launcher (a step-by-step builder like the dreamBot Builder) offers for DreamFly, in the shape the DreamDEX app's strategy catalog uses: one entry per environment variable, in the order a generated .env should list them. Names and defaults are the ones flybot.live.settings reads; tests/test_launcher_catalog.py keeps them in step.
name: DreamFly
description: A fruit fly's mushroom body picks, per market and per hour, which strategy to run (maker, grid, trend) or to sit out. One bot, all markets you give it, with a dashboard.
run: # save the .env above into this folder, then:

params.label: Network
params.help: One network per bot. testnet or mainnet run spot markets and event contracts; hideki runs perps, the only network that has them. A perp list on testnet or mainnet, or spot markets on hideki, is refused at start.

optionLabels.true: Dry run (logs what it would send)

params.label: Bot wallet key
params.help: Only for live. A wallet just for the bot, funded with SOMI for gas and USDso. Never your main key. Left as 0x... it is ignored.

params.label: Confirm mainnet live orders
params.help: Live orders on mainnet need this set to yes as well as DRY_RUN=false.

params.label: Spot markets
params.help: Comma separated. One fly each. The testnet has SOMI, WETH and WBTC; USDC.e:USDso exists on mainnet only.

params.label: Perp markets
params.help: Needs NETWORK=hideki. all for every market on the Hideki perp testnet (21), or a comma separated list such as BTC/USDso:USDso,ETH/USDso:USDso. With DRY_RUN=false the fly sends real perp orders on these markets.

params.label: Perps account (linked bot key)
params.help: Your DreamDEX account when PRIVATE_KEY is a bot key you linked to it in the app (wallet, Link a bot, Perps). Blank: the key trades its own perps account, which then needs USDso in its Perps balance.

params.label: Perp leverage
params.help: Live perp notional per market = live stake x this. 1 to 10. A linked account's own leverage cap, set in the app, still applies.

params.label: Event contracts
params.help: The mainnet BTC and ETH Up/Down windows. Paper in a dry run and on the testnet; with NETWORK=mainnet and DRY_RUN=false the fly bets the live stake once per window it picks.

params.label: Live stake per market (USDso)
params.help: The most one market has at work in live orders, whatever the paper stake.

params.label: Learning rule
params.help: delta: per-strategy readout warm-started on real candles (default). mb: the original depression-only readout.

params.label: Paper episodes at once per market
params.help: More episodes train the brain faster; only the first one places live orders.

params.label: Taker buffer through the touch (bps)
params.help: Use about 50 on the testnet, where quotes jump.

params.label: Dashboard password
params.help: Set it before you share the dashboard link. Blank leaves the dashboard open.

params.label: State directory
params.help: On Railway: add a volume at /data and set /data/state, or the fly forgets what it learned on every deploy.
